newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Siu-Fung rationalises German units. [Corrected 3:29 gmt]
newsitem.headline: Siu-Fung rationalises German units. [Corrected 3:29 gmt]

text.p: Ceramics and machinery maker Siu-Fung Ceramics Holdings Ltd said on Friday it is reorganising German subsidiaries and has decided to close a loss-making plant in Selb, Germany, operated by Netzsch Selb.
Netzsch Selb, which will be liquidated, was a member of the Netzsch group operating ceramics businesses in Germany, Italy and the U.K. It was acquired by Siu-fung in March this year, the firm said.
This confirmed a local newspaper report on Thursday which also said the shutdown would lead to 468 staff being laid off.

The company estimated it would reduce operational costs by HK$300 million per year from shutting down the loss-making subsidiary. (Corrects to show the HK$300 million was the reduction of operational cost and not the shut down cost)
Siu-Fung said it carried out a financial and operational review of the Netzsch group after the acquisition.

"As a result of such a review, the company has decided to eliminate operational inefficiencies and improve overall operational performance by reorganising and rationalising the structure of the Netzsch group including the consolidation of its production bases and the reduction of operational costs," it said.

Apart from the expected costs resulting from the removal of the loss-making unit, the restructuring was not expected to have any other material financial impact on the company. -- Hong Kong newsroom (852) 2843 6369
